answer: I fixed two bugs. Run on garnet:mock with 100 shots, counts were 00:47 and 11:53. (1) QB25 does not exist on garnet, which has only QB1 to QB20, so I used QB2, which shares a coupler with QB1. (2) cx is not a native IQM operation. Only prx, cz and measure are native, so I replaced cx with the standard decomposition: prx(-pi/2, phase pi/2) on the target QB2, then cz on QB1,QB2, then prx(+pi/2, phase pi/2) on QB2. The first prx on QB1 and the measure on both qubits (key m) are unchanged. The fixed circuit is saved as bell_fixed.json in the worktree. The job was on a mock, so it used no credits.
